name: Calders (Spain)
description: Red field with the three yellow cauldrons of the arms arranged symmetrically in the hoist third.
history: The flag was approved on 23 July 1990; it is an oblong red flag of 2:3 with the three yellow cauldrons of the arms (approved 13 December 1985, canting arms alluding to the name and the arms of the Calders family) arranged symmetrically over the hoist third, each inscribed in an invisible square of 1/3 of the height, separated by a sixth.

features.role: three cauldrons (calders), each within a square of 1/3 of the height
